title: Quiz results screen loads a background texture from a third-party CDN
detail: `bg-[url('https://www.transparenttextures.com/patterns/cubes.png')]` issues a request to transparenttextures.com, leaking a referrer at the exact moment the user finishes a quiz. It also contradicts the README's claim that data never leaves the browser, and renders as a flat gradient whenever the user is offline or blocking third parties.

title: Quiz generation re-fires whenever the book or summary object identity changes
detail: The effect depends on `[book, summary]` — objects, not ids. Any parent re-render that produces a fresh Summary reference triggers another paid generateContent call. React StrictMode double-invokes it in development, so every dev quiz costs two calls.

title: The Next Question button is a dark button on a dark footer in dark mode
detail: The footer is `bg-white dark:bg-gray-900` but the button is a hardcoded `bg-gray-900 text-white` with no dark variant, so the primary control of the quiz nearly vanishes against its own container.

title: Answer feedback colours have no dark variants
detail: Correct (emerald-100/800), wrong (red-100/800), selected (text-orange-800) and the explanation panel (bg-blue-50 / text-blue-800) are all light-only. In dark mode the answer states render as pale blocks with dark text against a dark modal.

title: Close button has no accessible name and answer feedback is not announced
detail: The icon-only X carries no aria-label, and the explanation panel that appears after answering has no aria-live region, so a screen-reader user gets no notification that feedback appeared.

title: Quiz generation has no cancellation path
detail: Closing the modal mid-generation leaves the request running and still writes review cards afterwards. There is no AbortController and no unmount guard.

title: An out-of-range correctAnswerIndex silently scores every answer wrong
detail: correctAnswerIndex comes straight from unvalidated model JSON. If it exceeds options.length no option ever matches, so the user answers correctly and still scores 0, with no indication anything is wrong. The same unvalidated value is persisted into the review deck at line 58.

title: Review cards are written one awaited transaction at a time
detail: A sequential await inside the loop serialises five independent IndexedDB writes.
